completions.completed_label: External Cervical Resorption of Maxillary Central Incisors
completions.reason: The vignette specifies the location of the external cervical resorption to be on the maxillary central incisors.
support_spans: Cone-beam computed tomography demonstrated radiolucent resorptive lesions cervically on the palatal aspects of teeth #11 and #21
The diagnosis for both central incisors was asymptomatic irreversible pulpitis with normal apical tissues and external cervical resorption
